<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex15012024-11-08-11-29" status="finalized">
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3807">'bre</rs> na re snga ma yang legs mod kyi phyi ma ches legs ste <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5633">phyir mi ldog pa 'khor lo'i mdo</rs> las | <expan>bcom ldan</expan> 'das kyis kun dga' bo la khyod song la dge slong dag bos shig gsung nas des de dag bsdus pa
            <lb n="52b2"/> dang | <expan>bcom ldan</expan> 'das kyis rgyal byed 'tshal du chu sngo la dang pa sprul nas ji ltar dge slong dag chu ma yin pa la chur 'du shes skyed pa de <expan>bzhin</expan> du de dag rgyun zhugs nas rang <expan>sangs rgyas</expan>  kyi bar dang phung po lnga ma yin pa la phung por 'du shes pa dag ste zhes pa nas | kun dga' po ngas khyod la dad pas rjes su 'brang pa dang chos kyi rjes su 'brang pa dang brgyad pa dang lan 1 phyir 'ong pa dang
            <lb n="52b3"/> phyir mi 'ong pa dang dgra bcom pa dang rang <expan>sangs rgyas</expan> su bstan pa bshad par bya'o || 
            kun dga' bo snyigs ma lngar skyes ba'i <expan>sems can</expan> dman pa la mos pa de <expan>dag gi</expan> ched du de <expan>bzhin</expan> gshegs pa thabs 'dis <expan>sangs rgyas</expan> kyi chos bstan to zhes de dag du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan mang du gsungs pa <expan>yin no</expan> zhes 'chad do || </seg></TEI>
source: 1_015_01_ 'Od zer mgon po _ mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi rnam par 'byed pa'i 'grel ba.xml
